text:
jamal: Quick sync: Catalyst asked for a clear schema for the power traces they'll send from NimbleX racks. They want to hand off csvs and a short summary PDF. Can someone draft the schema and minimal required fields?

mira: I can do schema for the ML side: timestamp (UTC iso), sample_id, board_id, model, seq_len, batch, token_count, inference_phase (cold|warm), tokens_per_sec, reported_power_w, ambient_temp_c. Add a run_id field to correlate with our CI.

oliver: Add counters for kernel events: gpu_util_pct, pcie_bandwidth_mb, mem_bandwidth_gbs, kernel_version, driver_version. Also include a checksum column for each file.

tanya: From infra: we'll need timezone-normalized timestamps and monotonic counters to merge with CI logs. Also ask Catalyst to include NTP sync status and the sw clock offset. If they can't guarantee ntp, we need start/end sync markers.

jamal: Good call. Priya, any marketing/legal constraints on what we can publish from partner-provided telemetry?

priya: Legal: we can't publish raw board serials or customer-only identifiers. Ask Catalyst to hash board_id and strip MAC addresses. For public plots we need aggregated perf/W with anonymized hardware bins. Also include a Partner Quote approval step in the timeline.

mira: On data format: prefer gzipped csvs in UTF-8 with newline-delimited rows and header. We'll accept a parquet fallback if they prefer columnar. Must include units in header comments.

oliver: For validation I'll add a small validator script that'll check headers, timestamp monotonicity, range sanity (power 0-2000 W, temp -10-120 C), and that checksums match manifest. I'll drop it in the repo as tools/validate_power_csv.py.

tanya: CI side: I'll create an SFTP + temporary presigned S3 bucket for uploads. We'll require a signed manifest file: manifest.json with file names, sha256, start_ts, end_ts. I'll automate ingest to our telemetry bucket and tag with bench-catalyst-<run_id>.

jamal: Timeline: ask Catalyst to send a sample trace (<= 1MB) by 2026-03-30 so we can validate schema. Full dataset by 2026-04-05 so runs can be reconciled.

mira: Tests we'll run on their sample: ingest -> validate -> join with our run logs -> compute tokens/s/W aggregated per minute and p95 latency join. If any mismatches, we fail-fast and request corrected CSV.

oliver: Also recommend they include a 'measurement_method' field: wattmeter model (PowerMon v2), sampling_rate_hz, calibration_date, and probe_location (board_side|psu_side). That affects perf/W interpretation.

priya: For the blog, we'll only show aggregated perf/W per model and a brief note on measurement method. We'll include a footnote like: "Measurements performed by Catalyst using PowerMon v2; per-board data anonymized." Need partner ok.

tanya: Security: we'll require files to be SFTP over FTPS or presigned S3. No email attachments. Also insist on PGP-signed manifest or S3-etag/sha256. I'll share the upload template.

jamal: Decision: keep raw telemetry private until both sides sign off. Public artifacts will be derived CSVs (aggregated) and the docker image + commands.

mira: Small addition: include a 'cache_state' field (cold|warm|hot) sampled at run start so we can separate first-token overhead vs steady-state.

oliver: I'll write a small README for Catalyst describing which syscalls/metrics we need enabled (perf counters, iostat, nvidia-smi sampling). Also a suggested kernel boot param snippet for reproducibility.

priya: I'll add a comms checklist: partner quote, data approval, disclaimer text, images, and legal sign-off. Target joint announcement window is 3 weeks post-run as discussed.

tanya: Bench-bot created upload workflow: bench-catalyst-3309990000-upload. It will email eng-sre and partnerships when new manifests appear.

jamal: Action items recap: Mira -> finalize csv schema & sample by 2026-03-30, Oliver -> validator + README, Tanya -> upload workflow & secure bucket, Priya -> comms checklist and approval path, Jamal -> send schema to Catalyst and request sample.

bench-bot: reminder: bench-catalyst-3309990000-upload will watch for manifests until 2026-04-12.

jamal: Thanks all  please drop PRs in the partnerships/bench-catalyst repo and tag me for review.
